items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You mentioned before that you were on the road with Richard Prior... I joined them in ’65, and I stayed until ’69. He was appearing on different bills with us.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, very well. We played a set together up in New York. He’s a very nice man, nice horn player. I maybe can get down, but I just don’t know. It’s all according to what changes I go through here.
You mentioned before that you were on the road with Richard Prior. Was that . . .
